claim_text: O’Brien and Phillips report a rescue in February 1988.
reported_outcome: A claimed escape and subsequent recovery.
verification_note: Authorship establishes narrative provenance, not independent proof of MONARCH or rescue particulars.

claim_text: Phillips describes an intensive journaling and memory-retrieval process.
reported_practice: Written recall and review of memories.
reported_outcome: Narrative reports reconstruction of autobiographical history.
verification_note: Not a clinically validated MONARCH reversal method; recovered content needs external corroboration.

claim_text: Phillips describes using trance or self-hypnosis techniques during the process.
reported_outcome: Narrative links these practices to recovered memories.
verification_note: Hypnosis can increase suggestibility; do not infer truth of memories from subjective vividness.

claim_text: Phillips describes long sessions and limitations on emotional expression during recollection.
verification_note: Record descriptively only; not a recommended clinical protocol.

claim_text: Taylor describes years of journaling and attempts to understand reported recovered memories.
reported_outcome: Taylor reports developing a coherent autobiographical account.
verification_note: An account of subjective experience; cannot verify the alleged program.

claim_text: Taylor reports working with therapists and people described as deprogrammers.
reported_practice: Professional or informal assistance as recounted.
reported_outcome: Taylor reports gradual recovery and integration.
verification_note: Providers and outcomes require independent corroboration; no endorsement of claimed techniques.

claim_text: Taylor describes the process as lengthy rather than instantaneous.
verification_note: Avoid coding as evidence of objective controller removal.

claim_text: Taylor describes memories and flashbacks as part of her experience.
verification_note: Flashbacks or narratives alone do not prove specific historical events.

claim_text: Historical reporting describes Linda Macdonald’s long-term harms after Cameron’s psychiatric experiments.
reported_outcome: Reported persistent memory impairment and harm.
verification_note: Do not assume that a specific recovery intervention was established.

claim_text: Dissociative disorder treatment guidelines recommend initial safety and stabilization.
reported_practice: Safety planning, symptom management, grounding, therapeutic alliance.
reported_outcome: Improved safety and functioning are treatment goals.
verification_note: Guideline is not proof of MONARCH programming.

claim_text: Phase-oriented guidance describes careful processing of traumatic material when clinically appropriate.
reported_practice: Gradual trauma processing under qualified care.
reported_outcome: Reduction in distress and trauma symptoms.
verification_note: Not instruction to recover hidden memories or uncover alleged handlers.

claim_text: Phase-oriented guidance discusses identity integration or coordination and rehabilitation.
reported_practice: Functional integration, relationships, daily life rehabilitation.
reported_outcome: Better everyday functioning is the goal.
verification_note: Identity integration is not uniformly defined as a single mandatory outcome.

claim_text: A systematic review assesses the effectiveness and limitations of phase-oriented dissociative-disorder treatment evidence.
reported_outcome: Benefits and study-quality limitations are evaluated.
verification_note: Distinguish observational findings from high-certainty causal estimates.

claim_text: VA/DoD guidance recommends CPT, PE and EMDR as evidence-based trauma-focused PTSD treatments.
reported_outcome: Reduction of PTSD symptoms in indicated patients.
verification_note: PTSD care is not a specific reversal of alleged MONARCH programming.

claim_text: APA states corroborating evidence is necessary to distinguish historically accurate memories from inaccurate ones.
reported_outcome: Improved confidence in historical attribution, not treatment efficacy.
verification_note: Do not treat subjective certainty or repeated recollection as independent sources.

claim_text: Suggestive recollection techniques can distort memory; hypnosis is not a historical truth test.
reported_practice: Avoid leading questions or coercive memory-recovery procedures.
reported_outcome: Reduction of risk of falsely attributing events.
verification_note: Ethical research should not attempt to induce trauma, dissociation or recovered memories.

claim_text: Recovery outcomes should be operationalized as safety, symptom burden and functioning rather than confirmation of a secret program.
reported_practice: Validated instruments and consent-based follow-up studies.
verification_note: Research proposal inferred from literature, not a direct quotation or historical finding.
